beats.caption: Clogher, in Irish An Clochar, in the civil parish of Donegal and the barony of Tirhugh. Here is the story of Clogher and its 33 families, from the 1850s to 1926.
Griffith's Valuation listed the land and its occupiers in the 1850s. Here, 54 plots are numbered for Clogher. The occupiers included Flanagan, Gallagher and Hone.
The parish register of Tawnawilly records seven baptisms at Clogher between 1873 and 1875. Its marriage entries give no townland, so none are placed here.
The censuses of 1901, 1911 and 1926 counted 125, 112 and 89 people in Clogher, in 27, 23 and 20 households. Heads of household included Flanagan, Hone and Cassidy.
